# Intake

## Inputs

`setup/client-intake.md`, current `run.json`, campaign goal, audience, approved offer, brand package, voice evidence, people and likeness decisions, evidence, platform route, reference files, and rights information.

## Process

Ask one unanswered blocking intake question at a time. Save the answer before asking the next question. Define one sharp idea and one action. Record confirmed facts and client assertions. Mark production judgments as heuristics. Keep unsupported gaps unknown. Register every usable file and its rights. Assign each reference one visual job. Verify the intended publishing route when practical.

## Outputs

Complete the client intake and shared brand controls. Complete the voice, people, asset, and claim records. Update `run.json` plus the reference register in `visual-brief.md`. Record the blockers too.

## Human check

Confirm scope and intended audience. Confirm the idea, offer, route, content class, hook-research format, and source packet. Confirm brand rules plus voice authority. Confirm likeness permissions and reference rights. Record intake approval before copy work proceeds.
